2.

These appeals are arising out of the judgment and award dated 23.01.2020 in MVC Nos.88/2016,
89/2016, 90/2016, 91/2016, 92/2016 and 87/2016, on the file of the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XIII and IV Additional District Judge at NC: 2026:KHC-K:1056 HC-KAR AND 3 OTHERS Vijayapur (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal'), awarding compensation.

sentences.text: 3. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties, these appeals are filed seeking enhancement of compensation.

4. In MVC No.87/2016 (MFA No.201677/2022), the deceased was aged about 58 years and taking into account the monthly salary of the deceased at Rs.8,000/- as per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority and as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation, reported in (2009) 6 SCC 121, the appropriate multiplier applicable is 9 and 1/4th of the income has to be deducted towards personal expenses of the deceased.

sentences.text: As per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi, reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680, 10% of the income has to be added towards NC: 2026:KHC-K:1056 HC-KAR AND 3 OTHERS future prospects.

ORDER I.
All the appeals are allowed in part.

In MVC No.87/2016 (MFA No.201677/2022), the deceased was aged about 58 years and taking into account the monthly salary of the deceased at Rs.8,000/- as per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority and as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case Sarla Verma Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation, reported in (2009) 6 SCC 121, the appropriate multiplier applicable is 9 and 1/4th of the income has to be deducted towards personal expenses of the deceased.
Hence,
the claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.7,12,800/- (Rs.8,000+10%= Rs.8,800x12x9x1/4th)
towards loss of dependency.
Accordingly the claimants are entitled for total compensation as under:
 Heads Amount Loss of dependency Rs.7,12,800/-
Loss of love and affection Rs.2,00,000/-
Towards funeral expenses Rs.15,000/-
Loss of estate Rs.15,000/-
Total Rs.9,42,800/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.7,22,500/-
Enhancement Rs.2,20,300/-
Thus, the clamant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.91,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.
9. In MVC No.92/2016 (MFA No.200875/2022), the compensation is reassessed by awarding global compensation of R.50,000/-, with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.
Thus, the clamant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.65,833/- rounded of to Rs.65,900/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.
